info.name: UnlearnArc Backend — Complete API
info.description:
Auto-generated from API_REFERENCE.md + full source code audit.

Base URL: http://localhost:8085/api/v1

## Auth model
- ADMIN  → POST /auth/login  → JWT stored in `adminToken`
- USER   → Google OAuth2 redirect → JWT stored manually in `userToken`

## Collection variables
| Variable | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `baseUrl` | http://localhost:8085/api/v1 |
| `adminToken` | Populated automatically by the Login request |
| `userToken` | Paste user JWT here after OAuth2 flow |
| `domainId` | Set after creating a domain |
| `skillId` | Set after creating a skill |
| `courseId` | Set after creating a course |
| `topicId` | Set after creating a topic |
| `materialId` | Set after creating a study material |
| `domainSkillMappingId` | Set after domain-skill mapping |
| `skillCourseMappingId` | Set after skill-course mapping |
| `userDomainMappingId` | Set after user-domain mapping |
| `poolId` | Set after creating a question pool |
| `questionId` | Set after creating a question |
| `userId` | Set after creating a user |

item.name: 1 · Admin Auth
item.description:
Admin email/password login, token refresh, and health check.
Base: /api/v1/auth

request.description: Public — no token required. Returns 200 with 'UnlearnArc API is running'.

Public — rate limited to 10 attempts / 60 s per IP.
Returns accessToken (24 h) + refreshToken (7 d).
Public — rotates both access and refresh tokens for the admin.
Requires ADMIN token. Returns the authenticated admin email.
Negative test — expects HTTP 401.

item.name: 2 · User Auth (OAuth2)
item.description:
Google OAuth2 flow endpoints for regular users.
Base: /api/v1/user-auth

Note: initiate OAuth2 flow in browser:
http://localhost:8085/oauth2/authorization/google

request.description: Public — rotates user access + refresh tokens. The refresh token must carry role=USER claim.
Requires USER or ADMIN token. Returns profile: id, name, email, region, rank, points, profilePicture, isActive.

item.name: User Token Refresh — Admin token rejected (expect 400)

request.description: Negative test — passing an admin refresh token to user-auth/refresh must be rejected.

item.name: 12 · Question Pools
item.description:
ADMIN: write   USER+: read
Base: /api/v1/question-pools

Business rule: easyCount + mediumCount + hardCount MUST equal totalQuestions.
timeLimitMinutes: 0 = unlimited.

request.description: scopeType enum: DOMAIN · COURSE · TOPIC

body.raw:
{
  "name": "JPA Topic Pool",
  "description": "Quick quiz for JPA topic",
  "scopeType": "TOPIC",
  "totalQuestions": 6,
  "easyCount": 2,
  "mediumCount": 2,
  "hardCount": 2,
  "passPercentage": 50,
  "timeLimitMinutes": 15
}

request.description: scopeType path param: DOMAIN · COURSE · TOPIC

Provide only the field matching the pool's scopeType:
- DOMAIN → domainId
- COURSE → courseId
- TOPIC  → topicId
Negative test — 3+3+4=10 ≠ totalQuestions(9) → must fail with 400.
Deletes pool AND all its scope mappings (domain/course/topic).

item.name: 13 · Questions
item.description:
ADMIN: write   USER+: read (answers returned WITHOUT isCorrect during active sessions)
Base: /api/v1/questions

NOTE: Run '12 · Create Pool' and map it to a course first.

body.raw:
{
  "poolId": "{{poolId}}",
  "questionText": "What does JVM stand for?",
  "questionType": "MCQ",
  "difficulty": "EASY",
  "points": 1,
  "explanation": "Java Virtual Machine — the runtime environment for Java bytecode.",
  "answers": [
    { "answerText": "Java Virtual Machine",  "isCorrect": true,  "displayOrder": 0 },
    { "answerText": "Java Verified Module",   "isCorrect": false, "displayOrder": 1 },
    { "answerText": "Java Variable Method",   "isCorrect": false, "displayOrder": 2 },
    { "answerText": "Just Very Much",         "isCorrect": false, "displayOrder": 3 }
  ]
}

request.description:
MCQ: exactly 1 isCorrect=true
Minimum 2 answer options required
Default points if omitted: EASY=1, MEDIUM=2, HARD=3

body.raw:
{
  "poolId": "{{poolId}}",
  "questionText": "Which of the following are valid Java access modifiers?",
  "questionType": "MULTIPLE_CORRECT",
  "difficulty": "MEDIUM",
  "points": 2,
  "explanation": "Java has four access modifiers: public, protected, default (package-private), and private.",
  "answers": [
    { "answerText": "public",    "isCorrect": true,  "displayOrder": 0 },
    { "answerText": "protected", "isCorrect": true,  "displayOrder": 1 },
    { "answerText": "private",   "isCorrect": true,  "displayOrder": 2 },
    { "answerText": "internal",  "isCorrect": false, "displayOrder": 3 }
  ]
}

request.description:
MULTIPLE_CORRECT: ≥ 2 isCorrect=true answers required
Full marks only if ALL correct answers selected AND no incorrect ones.
Creates all 8 remaining questions (plus the 1 MCQ already created = 9 total matching pool distribution).
difficulty path param: EASY · MEDIUM · HARD

body.raw:
{
  "poolId": "{{poolId}}",
  "questionText": "What does JVM stand for? (revised)",
  "questionType": "MCQ",
  "difficulty": "EASY",
  "points": 1,
  "explanation": "JVM = Java Virtual Machine.",
  "answers": [
    { "answerText": "Java Virtual Machine",  "isCorrect": true,  "displayOrder": 0 },
    { "answerText": "Just Very Much",         "isCorrect": false, "displayOrder": 1 },
    { "answerText": "Java Verified Module",   "isCorrect": false, "displayOrder": 2 },
    { "answerText": "Java Variable Method",   "isCorrect": false, "displayOrder": 3 }
  ]
}

request.description: Replaces ALL answers. Provide the full updated answer list.
Negative test — MCQ with 0 correct answers must be rejected with 400.
Negative test — MULTIPLE_CORRECT requires ≥ 2 correct answers.
